subdivide_meshes_forward: subdivide a batch of triangle meshes by adding mid-edge vertices and splitting each face into four
subdivide_meshes_subdivide_faces: compute the new subdivided face indices for a mesh by splitting each triangular face into four smaller faces
subdivide_meshes_subdivide_homogeneous: subdivide a batch of meshes with identical face topology using precomputed face indices for efficiency
create_verts_index: create a reordering index tensor to group existing and new vertices sequentially per mesh after subdivision
create_faces_index: create a reordering index tensor to group existing and new faces sequentially per mesh after subdivision
